title: Self-employed designer just curious
scenario: Leo is a self-employed graphic designer who says he's not ready, just curious whether he could ever qualify. The rep handles the approval question carefully and books a document review.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hey Leo, it's Sam with Copperleaf Home Loans. You'd sent us a question through the website about self-employed loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh yeah. Hey. Yeah, I'm not ready to buy or anything, I was just curious.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a great time to ask, honestly, before you're in a rush. How long have you been self-employed?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: About three years now. Freelance design, mostly branding work.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Mostly small stuff, a couple breweries, a coffee roaster. I did a taco truck logo I'm weirdly proud of.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, those are the best ones. So what made you curious about buying?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: My rent went up again. And everyone keeps saying self-employed people can't get mortgages. Is that true? Would I even get approved?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It's definitely not true that you can't. It just looks different, we usually look at your tax returns rather than pay stubs. Whether you'd qualify really depends on what your returns show, so I can't say yes or no until I see them.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, my accountant writes off basically everything.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's really common, and it's exactly why it's worth looking early. Sometimes a small change in how you file this year makes a big difference later.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, interesting. I didn't know that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: If you're open to it, I could look at your last two years of returns and tell you honestly where you stand. No commitment.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure, I can do that. Would you need anything else?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Maybe a year-to-date profit and loss if you have one, but returns are the main thing. Would it be easier to upload them this week or next?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: This week. I'll ask my accountant to send them.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. I'll text you a secure upload link. Thanks Leo.
